camel_example: aliyun ossutil api post-object --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou --content--type application/x-www-form-urlencoded --null "key=example.jpg"
description_en: Upload a file (Object) to a specified bucket by using an HTML form
description_zh: 通过HTML表单上传的方式将文件（Object）上传到指定存储空间（Bucket）
name: PostObject

parameters.help_en: The name of the Object to upload, without encoding. If the name includes a path, such as destfolder/example.jpg, OSS automatically creates the corresponding folders. Default Value: None
parameters.help_zh: 上传Object的名称，无需编码。如果名称包含路径，例如destfolder/example.jpg，则OSS会自动创建相应的文件夹。 默认值：无
parameters.name: key
